reviews.review:
After years of building on what I learned from the first game, this sequel is finally out in Early Access. It’s bigger, smarter, and built to grow with the community.

What’s different from BGVR1?

New battle system: Combat now fully embraces 3D maneuvering with six shield arcs instead of four, making positioning and tactics matter more than ever.

More ships: Twice as many ship classes and a cleaner, more modular codebase for future updates.

Better UI: Everything’s standardized for smoother control from the bridge.

The Gauntlet: A combat-focused mode with randomized missions, rewards, and escalating challenges — risk and reward with permanent gains and losses.

Open World: A procedurally generated galaxy filled with missions, factions, pirates, mining, and trading. Play and grow however you choose.

Reworked Conquest: Build and supply stations, lay down or destroy warp lanes, and coordinate with others to push your faction’s borders. Player factions are coming.

Co-op and Multiplayer: Planned for later in Early Access.

It’s not finished, but it’s already fully playable — and I’ll be expanding it constantly with your feedback. If you liked the first game please check it out!
